title: Ensure hidden YouTube link video plays reliably on user interaction

requirements.text: Make the hidden YouTube playback start reliably for the provided link "https://youtu.be/FJuR5mfEU_k?si=gUWQCKXNK-ivBMOB" after the first user interaction (tap/click/keypress), even if that interaction happens before the YouTube player finishes initializing.
acceptanceCriteria: On a fresh page load, the YouTube player is initialized once and remains non-visible (no new visible UI is introduced).
If the user taps/clicks before the YouTube player is ready, playback still starts automatically as soon as the player becomes ready (without requiring a second interaction).
If the YouTube player is already ready when the first interaction occurs, playback starts immediately on that interaction.
No repeated player initialization occurs during normal interactions (including scrolling).

requirements.text: After the first user interaction, ensure the hidden YouTube video plays with audible audio (unmuted) unless browser policy blocks unmuting; in that case, keep playing and unmute as soon as a permitted user gesture occurs, without adding any visible controls.
acceptanceCriteria: After the first user interaction, the YouTube player attempts to unmute and play.
If unmute is blocked by browser policy, the app does not crash or blank; it retries unmuting only on a subsequent permitted user gesture.
No visible controls, buttons, overlays, or layout/styling/text/animation changes are introduced to support YouTube playback.

constraints: Do not add or change any visible UI, layout, styling, text, or animations; YouTube playback must remain hidden/non-visible.
Use the exact YouTube link provided: https://youtu.be/FJuR5mfEU_k?si=gUWQCKXNK-ivBMOB.
Frontend must not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Adding a visible YouTube embed or any on-screen media controls.
Changing or removing existing Valentine’s Day sections, animations, or copy.
Backend changes (Motoko) or storing playback state server-side.
